def plaquette_hessian(q, coefficient=.7):
    """K4*||U_square-I||_HS^2/2: Tr(Ta Tb)=delta/2."""
    d = 1-np.exp(1j*q)
    result = np.zeros((105, 105), dtype=complex)
    for a, b in itertools.combinations(range(3), 2):
        curl = np.zeros((15, 105), dtype=complex)
        curl[:, 60+15*a:75+15*a] = d[b]*np.eye(15)
        curl[:, 60+15*b:75+15*b] = -d[a]*np.eye(15)
        result += coefficient/2*curl.conj().T@curl
    return result


def rank_support(G):
    _, singular, right = np.linalg.svd(G, full_matrices=False)
    tolerance = 1e-7*max(1., float(singular[0]))
    rank = int(np.sum(singular > tolerance))
    return rank, singular, right[:rank].conj().T, right[rank:].conj().T


def restoring_sectors(strong, leading, G):
    """Rank/count discriminant before applying either kinetic trajectory."""
    quotient = null_space(G.conj().T, rcond=1e-12)
    values, vectors = np.linalg.eigh(hermitian(quotient.conj().T@strong@quotient, 'strong quotient'))
    tolerance = 1e-8*max(1., float(np.max(abs(values))))
    kernel = quotient@vectors[:, abs(values) <= tolerance]
    uniform = np.linalg.eigvalsh(hermitian(kernel.conj().T@leading@kernel, 'nonstiff leading quotient'))
    return dict(physical_quotient_dimension=quotient.shape[1],
        strong_quotient_eigenvalues=values, strong_positive_rank=int(np.sum(values > tolerance)),
        strong_negative_count=int(np.sum(values < -tolerance)),
        nonstiff_normal_count=kernel.shape[1], nonstiff_original_heavy_eigenvalues=uniform,
        nonstiff_leading_negative_count=int(np.sum(uniform < -2e-6)),
        rank_tolerance=tolerance,
        scope='Euclidean native Gauss quotient rank; nonstationary Hessian is not an equilibrium claim')


def charge_form(G, field_cometric, u4) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Complete Cartesian constrained minimum, including resolved stabilizers."""
    a = np.concatenate((np.full(60, field_cometric), np.full(45, 2*u4)))
    mass = 1/a
    rank, singular, support, stabilizer = rank_support(G)
    weighted = G.conj().T@(mass[:, None]*G)
    reduced = hermitian(support.conj().T@weighted@support, 'supported Gauss mass', relative=True)
    inverse = np.linalg.solve(reduced, np.eye(rank))
    S = support@inverse@support.conj().T
    horizontal = hermitian(np.diag(a)-G@S@G.conj().T, 'horizontal cometric', relative=True)
    inertia = hermitian(G[:60].conj().T@G[:60], 'actual Cartesian inertia')
    return dict(a=a, mass=mass, S=S, horizontal=horizontal, weighted=weighted,
                rank=rank, singular=singular, support=support, stabilizer=stabilizer,
                inertia=inertia)




def longitudinal_minimum(G, form, rho):
    """Reject unsupported charge instead of dropping stabilizer constraints."""
    unsupported = float(np.linalg.norm(form['stabilizer'].conj().T@rho))
    if unsupported > 1e-9*max(1., float(np.linalg.norm(rho))):
        raise ValueError('Inhomogeneous Gauss charge has a resolved stabilizer component')
    momentum = form['mass']*(G@form['S']@rho)
    return momentum, float(np.vdot(rho, form['S']@rho).real/2)


def charge_controls(G, form):
    rng = np.random.default_rng(222907)
    rho = form['support']@(rng.normal(size=form['rank'])+1j*rng.normal(size=form['rank']))
    p, schur = longitudinal_minimum(G, form, rho)
    cost = float(np.vdot(p, form['a']*p).real/2)
    Z = null_space(G.conj().T, rcond=1e-12)
    delta = Z@(rng.normal(size=Z.shape[1])+1j*rng.normal(size=Z.shape[1]))
    displaced = float(np.vdot(p+delta, form['a']*(p+delta)).real/2)
    controls = dict(full_Gauss_residual=float(np.linalg.norm(G.conj().T@p-rho)),
        constrained_cost=cost, Schur_cost=schur, completion_error=abs(cost-schur),
        adverse_horizontal_displacement_cost=displaced,
        exact_excess=float(np.vdot(delta, form['a']*delta).real/2),
        completion_excess_error=abs(displaced-cost-float(np.vdot(delta, form['a']*delta).real/2)),
        horizontal_cometric_residual=float(np.linalg.norm(form['horizontal']@(form['mass'][:, None]*G))))
    check(controls['full_Gauss_residual'], 'inhomogeneous complete Gauss')
    check(controls['completion_error']/max(1., cost), 'complete charge Schur')
    check(controls['completion_excess_error']/max(1., displaced), 'complete square adverse')
    check(controls['horizontal_cometric_residual'], 'mass horizontal quotient', 3e-7)
    return controls


def general_principal(potential, G, field_cometric, u4, Lambda, *, source_gauge_null):
    """General kinetic law; independent original interface cross-control."""
    form = charge_form(G, field_cometric, u4)
    mass = form['mass']
    Z = null_space((np.sqrt(mass)[:, None]*G@form['support']).conj().T, rcond=1e-12)
    root = np.sqrt(form['a'])
    reduced = hermitian(Z.conj().T@(root[:, None]*potential*root[None])@Z,
                        'original full105 physical principal', relative=True)
    eigenvalues, vectors = np.linalg.eigh(reduced)
    modes = root[:, None]*(Z@vectors)
    participation = np.sum(abs((Z@vectors)[:60])**2, axis=0)
    # z=R*z_old gives exactly the old principal_modes mass convention.
    R = np.concatenate((np.full(60, np.sqrt(field_cometric/np.sqrt(Lambda))), np.ones(45)))
    inherited = principal_modes(R[:, None]*potential*R[None]/Lambda,
                                G/R[:, None], Lambda=Lambda, ue4=u4)
    residual = float(np.max(abs(inherited['squared_frequencies']-eigenvalues))/max(1., np.max(abs(eigenvalues))))
    check(residual, 'source-owned principal_modes interface', 2e-8)
    curvature = eigenvalues/np.sum(abs(modes)**2, axis=0)
    resolution = spectral_resolution(reduced, eigenvalues, vectors)
    quotient = null_space(G.conj().T, rcond=1e-12)
    quotient_potential = hermitian(quotient.conj().T@potential@quotient, 'unweighted physical potential', relative=True)
    potential_values, potential_vectors = np.linalg.eigh(quotient_potential)
    potential_resolution = spectral_resolution(quotient_potential, potential_values, potential_vectors)
    return dict(gauge_rank=form['rank'], stabilizer_dimension=15-form['rank'],
        source_gauge_null_at_reported_resolution=source_gauge_null,
        scope='Stationary gauge-null normal form' if source_gauge_null else 'Off-stationary slice diagnostics; no mass-independent physical-sign verdict',
        normal_dimension=len(eigenvalues), squared_frequencies=eigenvalues,
        frequencies=np.sqrt(np.maximum(0., eigenvalues)),
        growth_rates=np.sqrt(np.maximum(0., -eigenvalues)),
        field_kinetic_participation=participation,
        physical_potential_curvature=curvature,
        resolved_negative_count=int(np.sum((curvature < -2e-6) & (eigenvalues < -resolution))),
        numerically_unresolved_count=int(np.sum(abs(eigenvalues) <= resolution)),
        numerically_unresolved_frequency_mask=abs(eigenvalues) <= resolution,
        floating_frequency_squared_resolution=resolution,
        euclidean_slice_potential_eigenvalues=potential_values,
        euclidean_slice_potential_resolution=potential_resolution,
        euclidean_slice_potential_resolved_negative_count=int(np.sum(potential_values < -potential_resolution)),
        mass_independent_potential_resolved_negative_count=int(np.sum(potential_values < -potential_resolution)) if source_gauge_null else None,
        mass_independent_potential_positive_at_reported_resolution=bool(np.min(potential_values) > potential_resolution) if source_gauge_null else None,
        raw_negative_count=int(np.sum(eigenvalues < 0)),
        full_mass_Gauss_residual=float(np.linalg.norm(G.conj().T@(mass[:, None]*modes))),
        inherited_principal_interface_relative_error=residual,
        kinetic_normal_basis=Z, coordinate_modes=modes), form


def slater_geometry(model, q):
    """Actual TOTAL Slater QGT, colour density/covariance; no forced block fill."""
    metrics = [np.zeros((105, 105), dtype=np.complex128) for _ in range(2)]
    covariances = [np.zeros((15, 15), dtype=np.complex128) for _ in range(2)]
    targets = model.shifted_indices(q)
    for start in range(0, model.count, 128):
        indices = np.arange(start, min(start+128, model.count))
        target = targets[indices]
        left = model.vectors[target].conj().transpose(0, 2, 1)
        right = model.vectors[indices]
        denominator = model.values[target, :, None]-model.values[indices, None, :]
        vertex = model.vertices(indices, q, target)
        transitions = np.einsum('pei,paij,pjo->paeo', left, vertex, right)
        charges = np.einsum('pei,aij,pjo->paeo', left, model.generators, right)
        for species in range(2):
            occupied = model.occupied if species == 0 else ~model.occupied
            mask = (~occupied[target, :, None]) & occupied[indices, None, :]
            inverse = np.zeros_like(denominator)
            np.divide(1., denominator, out=inverse, where=mask)
            feature = (transitions*inverse[:, None]).transpose(1, 0, 2, 3).reshape(105, -1)
            metrics[species] += feature.conj()@feature.T/model.count
            charge = (charges*mask[:, None]).transpose(1, 0, 2, 3).reshape(15, -1)
            covariances[species] += charge.conj()@charge.T/model.count
    metric, light_metric = metrics
    covariance, light_covariance = covariances
    mean = np.einsum('pij,aji->a', model.projector, model.generators).real/model.count
    light_projector = np.eye(4)[None]-model.projector
    light_mean = np.einsum('pij,aji->a', light_projector, model.generators).real/model.count
    G = model.gauge_columns(q)
    ward = float(np.linalg.norm(G.conj().T@metric@G-covariance))
    check(ward, 'Slater angular covariance equals actual QGT pullback', 3e-7)
    light_ward = float(np.linalg.norm(G.conj().T@light_metric@G-light_covariance))
    check(light_ward, 'complementary light angular QGT covariance', 3e-7)
    berry_cancellation = float(np.linalg.norm((metric+light_metric).imag)) if np.linalg.norm(q) == 0 else None
    if berry_cancellation is not None:
        check(berry_cancellation, 'actual q0 complementary Berry cancellation', 3e-7)
    check(float(np.linalg.norm(mean+light_mean)), 'complement light vacuum mean cancellation')
    return dict(metric=hermitian(metric, 'Slater QGT'), covariance=hermitian(covariance, 'Slater covariance'),
        complementary_light_metric=hermitian(light_metric, 'complement light QGT'),
        complementary_light_covariance=hermitian(light_covariance, 'complement light covariance'),
        heavy_colour_mean=mean, complementary_light_mean=light_mean,
        mean_cancellation_error=float(np.linalg.norm(mean+light_mean)),
        angular_QGT_covariance_error=ward,
        complementary_light_angular_QGT_covariance_error=light_ward,
        q0_complementary_Berry_cancellation_error=berry_cancellation,
        q0_Berry_curvature=2*metric.imag if np.linalg.norm(q) == 0 else None,
        occupied_count=int(np.sum(model.occupied)),
        occupation_histogram={str(n): int(np.sum(model.occupied.sum(axis=1) == n)) for n in range(5)},
        whole_particle_hole_gap=model.gap,
        heavy_sign='-Lambda*dGamma(h); largest TOTAL 2V modes',
        light_complement='negative cluster of the same frozen +dGamma(h), not an independent imposed local sea',
        normalization='per-cell QGT/covariance; Fourier charge operators use 1/sqrt(V)')


def singular_inertia_control(basis):
    """An actual Cartan field keeps its five Lie stabilizers at q0."""
    frame = np.zeros((4, 4, 4), dtype=complex)
    frame[0] = np.diag([5., 1., 1., -7.])
    D = np.array([coordinates(1j*(T@frame-frame@T), basis).reshape(-1)
                  for T in basis/np.sqrt(8)]).T
    G = np.vstack((D, np.zeros((45, 15))))
    form = charge_form(G, 1., .3)
    if form['rank'] != 10 or form['stabilizer'].shape[1] != 5:
        raise AssertionError('Native Cartan stabilizer was deleted by mass weighting')
    rejected = False
    try:
        longitudinal_minimum(G, form, form['stabilizer'][:, 0])
    except ValueError:
        rejected = True
    if not rejected:
        raise AssertionError('Unsupported inhomogeneous stabilizer charge was silently removed')
    return dict(actual_Cartan_q0_gauge_rank=form['rank'], stabilizer_dimension=5,
        gauge_singular_values=form['singular'], unsupported_charge_rejected=rejected,
        supported_charge_completion=charge_controls(G, form))


def projected_terms(model, q, geometry, form):
    metric, covariance = geometry['metric'], geometry['covariance']
    normal_BH = float(np.trace(form['horizontal']@metric).real/2)
    angular_variance = float(np.trace(form['S']@covariance).real/2)
    full_BH = float(np.einsum('a,aa->', form['a'], metric).real/2)
    light_normal_BH = float(np.trace(form['horizontal']@geometry['complementary_light_metric']).real/2)
    light_angular_variance = float(np.trace(form['S']@geometry['complementary_light_covariance']).real/2)
    check(abs(full_BH-normal_BH-angular_variance)/max(1., full_BH), 'normal/angular BH decomposition')
    # Operator on the actual four-dimensional fundamental; mean is relevant at q0.
    mean = geometry['heavy_colour_mean'] if np.linalg.norm(q) == 0 else np.zeros(15)
    inverse = form['S'].real
    fundamental = sum(inverse[a, b]*model.generators[a]@model.generators[b]/(2*model.count)
                      for a in range(15) for b in range(15))
    linear = sum((inverse@mean)[a]*model.generators[a] for a in range(15))
    charge_operator = hermitian(fundamental+linear, 'projected light charge operator')
    spectrum = np.linalg.eigvalsh(charge_operator)
    # This four-colour probe is an operator diagnostic, not an unreferenced physical state.
    scalar_part = np.trace(charge_operator).real/4
    difference = float(np.linalg.norm(charge_operator-scalar_part*np.eye(4)))
    vertex = model.vertices(np.array([0]), q, model.shifted_indices(q)[:1])[0]
    # Explicit indexing avoids NumPy's mixed-index axis reordering.
    positive = model.vectors[0][:, model.occupied[0]]
    compressed = np.einsum('ie,aij,jf->aef', positive.conj(), vertex, positive)
    traceless = vertex-np.trace(vertex, axis1=1, axis2=2)[:, None, None]/4*np.eye(4)[None]
    normal_vertices = np.einsum('ai,aef->ief', null_space(model.gauge_columns(q).conj().T), traceless)
    return dict(heavy_common_normal_Born_Huang=normal_BH,
        heavy_common_angular_variance=angular_variance, heavy_full_Born_Huang=full_BH,
        BH_decomposition_error=abs(full_BH-normal_BH-angular_variance),
        complementary_vacuum_normal_BH=normal_BH+light_normal_BH,
        complementary_light_normal_BH=light_normal_BH,
        independent_complementary_vacuum_angular_variance=angular_variance+light_angular_variance,
        complementary_light_angular_variance=light_angular_variance,
        complementary_vacuum_Berry='trace connection/curvature cancels at q0; independent species variances ADD',
        heavy_Berry_charge_mean=mean,
        heavy_mean_only_q0_angular_cost_total=float(model.count*np.vdot(mean, form['S']@mean).real/2),
        heavy_variance_is_scalar_on_retained_light_Fock=True,
        light_fundamental_charge_operator=charge_operator,
        light_fundamental_charge_eigenvalues=spectrum,
        light_charge_operator_nonscalar_norm=difference,
        quadratic_fundamental_nonscalar_norm=float(np.linalg.norm(fundamental-np.trace(fundamental).real/4*np.eye(4))),
        heavy_mean_linear_light_eigenvalues=np.linalg.eigvalsh(linear),
        actual_light_normal_vertex_nonscalar_norm=float(np.linalg.norm(normal_vertices)),
        retained_positive_cluster_q0_vertices=compressed if np.linalg.norm(q) == 0 else None,
        charge_operator_scope='single-colour local algebra probe only; physical charged trial needs explicit bar4/negative-charge reference',
        remaining_operator_premise='Uniform isolated normal bundle/resolvent control, bounded covariant whole-heavy projector derivatives and operator-valued light-current transfer with all torons/full Gauss. Not implied by Hessian or shape selection.')




def pair_reference(model, q, form, separation):
    """Exact fund(x) tensor static bar4(y) singlet, no fake scalar reference."""
    singlet = np.eye(4).reshape(-1)/2
    local = np.array([np.kron(T, np.eye(4)) for T in model.generators])
    reference = np.array([-np.kron(np.eye(4), T.T) for T in model.generators])
    total = local+reference
    error = float(np.linalg.norm(total@singlet))
    check(error, 'physical fund plus static bar4 reference Gauss singlet')
    phase = np.exp(1j*np.dot(q, separation))
    rho = (local+phase*reference)/np.sqrt(model.count)
    image = rho@singlet
    C = image.conj()@image.T
    predicted = abs(1-phase)**2/(8*model.count)*np.eye(15)
    check(float(np.linalg.norm(C-predicted)), 'physical reference exact Fourier covariance')
    cost = float(np.trace(form['S']@C).real/2)
    wrong = np.eye(15)/(8*model.count)
    wrong_cost = float(np.trace(form['S']@wrong).real/2)
    return dict(reference='static anti-fundamental bar4 at y; no co-rotation and no scalar colour reservoir',
        separation=np.asarray(separation), exact_pair_singlet_Gauss_residual=error,
        Fourier_charge_covariance=C, exact_reference_Coulomb_cost=cost,
        reference_omitted_adverse_cost=wrong_cost,
        q0_reference_total_charge_exactly_zero=bool(np.linalg.norm(q) == 0 and np.linalg.norm(C) < 1e-20),
        note='This is the added pair charge form, not an eigenstate of the interacting heavy/light/background Hamiltonian.')


def native_control(model, centre_angles):
    law = BulkQuantumLaw(model.size, band=model.band)
    fields = np.tile(model.frame, (law.volume, 1, 1, 1))
    links = law.toron_links(centre_angles)
    h = law.onebody(fields, links)
    values = np.linalg.eigvalsh(h)
    expected = np.sort(model.values.reshape(-1))
    error = float(np.max(abs(values-expected)))
    check(model.band.a*error, 'native endpoint/whole Bloch spectrum', 3e-8)
    return dict(native_endpoint_spectrum_max_error=error,
        native_whole_occupied=int(len(values)//2), native_spectrum=values,
        geometry_owner='BulkQuantumLaw.onebody only; its local selector is NEVER executed or added')


def adverse_whole_filling(band):
    """Native traceless Cartan torons really transfer whole occupation."""
    law = BulkQuantumLaw(3, band=band)
    frame = np.zeros((4, 4, 4), dtype=complex)
    frame[0] = np.diag([5., 1., 1., -7.])
    angles = np.array([[.5, -.3, .7], [-.2, .6, -.5], [.8, -.9, .1]])
    angles = np.vstack((angles, -angles.sum(axis=0)))
    links = law.identity_links()
    for x, site in enumerate(law.sites):
        for axis in range(3):
            if site[axis] == 2:
                links[x, axis] = np.diag(np.exp(1j*angles[:, axis]))
    fields = np.tile(frame, (law.volume, 1, 1, 1))
    values, vectors = np.linalg.eigh(law.onebody(fields, links))
    P = vectors[:, 2*law.volume:]@vectors[:, 2*law.volume:].conj().T
    density = np.array([np.trace(P[4*x:4*x+4, 4*x:4*x+4]@T).real
                        for T in law.generators for x in range(law.volume)]).reshape(15, law.volume).mean(axis=1)
    blocks = np.array([coefficients(band, (2*np.pi*law.sites+angles[i])/(3*band.a))[:, 0]*frame[0, i, i].real
                       for i in range(4)]).T
    sorted_blocks = np.sort(blocks, axis=1)
    wrong = -float(sorted_blocks[:, 2:].sum()/law.volume)
    actual = -float(values[2*law.volume:].sum()/law.volume)
    counts = np.zeros(blocks.size, dtype=bool)
    counts[np.argsort(blocks.reshape(-1), kind='stable')[-2*law.volume:]] = True
    histogram = {str(n): int(np.sum(counts.reshape(-1, 4).sum(axis=1) == n)) for n in range(5)}
    error = float(np.max(abs(np.sort(blocks.reshape(-1))-values)))
    check(band.a*error, 'native arbitrary Cartan toron control', 3e-8)
    if band.a*(wrong-actual) <= 1e-5:
        raise AssertionError('Whole-half adverse filling transfer not reached')
    return dict(native_spectrum_error=error, native_whole_half_energy=actual,
        wrong_two_per_block_energy=wrong, rejected_forced_block_error=wrong-actual,
        actual_occupation_histogram=histogram, actual_heavy_colour_mean=density,
        frame='diag(5,1,1,-7) in orbital0; other orbitals zero',
        traceless_colour_toron_angles=angles, scope='adverse non-Clifford native law, not selected equilibrium')


def run(*, frame_grid=16, grids=(3, 4, 8), lambdas=(1e4, 1e8), spacing=1., p=.5, s=.5,
        q_indices=((0, 0, 0), (1, 0, 0), (1, 1, 1)), centre=(0, 0, 0), separation=(1, 0, 0),
        native_frame_toron=False) -> dict[str, Any]:
    if frame_grid < 3 or any(n < 3 for n in grids):
        raise ValueError('Original native distinct-nearest-path box requires grids >=3')
    if not 0 < spacing <= 1 or not 0 < p < 1.25 or not 0 < s < 1:
        raise ValueError('Need 0<a<=1, 0<p<5/4, 0<s<1 for the declared two trajectories')
    if any(not np.isfinite(L) or L < 1 for L in lambdas):
        raise ValueError('Lambda must be finite >=1')
    if len(centre) != 3 or any(int(c) != c for c in centre):
        raise ValueError('Centre torons use three integer Z4 labels')
    identities = source_hashes()
    band = RotationBand(**{**BARE, 'a': spacing})
    basis = matrix_unit_basis()
    angles = np.pi/2*np.asarray(centre, dtype=int)
    selected, frame = original_frame(band, frame_grid, angles, native_frame_toron)
    value = coordinates(frame, basis).reshape(-1)
    grid_rows = []
    for size in grids:
        model = OriginalSpatial(band, size, basis, value, angles)
        dimensionless_band = RotationBand(**{**BARE, 'a': 1., 'm': spacing*band.m})
        dimensionless = OriginalSpatial(dimensionless_band, size, basis, value, angles)
        rows = []
        for supplied in q_indices:
            index = np.asarray(supplied, dtype=int)
            q = 2*np.pi*index/size
            parts = model.hessian_parts(q)
            G = model.gauge_columns(q)
            strong = parts['alignment']+plaquette_hessian(q)
            leading = parts['local']+parts['sea']+parts['contact']
            # Check the source-scale gradient/H0, not a stiff-dominated Lambda
            # matrix whose relative gauge defect can hide nonstationarity.
            source_gauge_null = bool(np.linalg.norm(band.a*model.gradient) <= 2e-8
                and np.linalg.norm(band.a*leading@G) <= 3e-8)
            geometry = slater_geometry(model, q)
            check(float(np.linalg.norm(strong@G)), 'strong positive gauge Hessian', 3e-8)
            ward = model.ward(q, parts)
            I = G[:60].conj().T@G[:60]
            b = float(np.sum(abs(1-np.exp(1j*q))**2))
            trajectories = []
            for trajectory in ('original_fast_field', 'explicit_slow_field'):
                scales = []
                for Lambda in lambdas:
                    kfield = np.sqrt(Lambda) if trajectory == 'original_fast_field' else Lambda**(-s)
                    u4 = .3*Lambda**(-p)
                    potential = Lambda*leading+Lambda**1.25*strong
                    principal, form = general_principal(potential, G, kfield, u4, Lambda,
                        source_gauge_null=source_gauge_null)
                    matrix_identity = I/kfield+b/(2*u4)*np.eye(15)
                    check(float(np.linalg.norm(form['weighted']-matrix_identity))/max(1., np.linalg.norm(matrix_identity)), 'actual inertia plus complete incidence')
                    modes = principal.pop('coordinate_modes')
                    principal.pop('kinetic_normal_basis')
                    scales.append(dict(Lambda=Lambda, field_cometric=kfield, u4=u4,
                        potential_eigenvalues=np.linalg.eigvalsh(potential),
                        principal=principal, actual_charge_Schur_matrix=form['S'],
                        charge_Schur_eigenvalues=np.linalg.eigvalsh(form['S']),
                        Gauss_mass_matrix=form['weighted'], charge_controls=charge_controls(G, form),
                        projected_BO_terms=projected_terms(model, q, geometry, form),
                        physical_reference=pair_reference(model, q, form, separation),
                        coordinate_mode_norms=np.sum(abs(modes)**2, axis=0)))
                if len(scales) > 1 and len(set(lambdas)) == len(lambdas):
                    low, high = min(scales, key=lambda x: x['Lambda']), max(scales, key=lambda x: x['Lambda'])
                    ratio = np.log(high['Lambda']/low['Lambda'])
                    omega_low = low['principal']['frequencies']
                    omega_high = high['principal']['frequencies']
                    power = np.full_like(omega_low, np.nan)
                    positive = ((omega_low > 0) & (omega_high > 0)
                        & ~low['principal']['numerically_unresolved_frequency_mask']
                        & ~high['principal']['numerically_unresolved_frequency_mask'])
                    power[positive] = np.log(omega_high[positive]/omega_low[positive])/ratio
                    # A missing logarithmic exponent is null, never a fabricated zero or NaN JSON.
                    exponents = [float(x) if np.isfinite(x) else None for x in power]
                else:
                    exponents = None
                trajectories.append(dict(name=trajectory, scales=scales,
                    sorted_frequency_finite_log_slopes=exponents,
                    slopes_scope='finite diagnostics by sorted eigenvalue, not identified branches or asymptotic proof'))
            rows.append(dict(q_index=index, q_angular=q, q_physical=q/spacing,
                native_gauge_columns=G, field_Cartesian_inertia=I,
                inertia_eigenvalues=np.linalg.eigvalsh(I), incidence_norm_squared=b,
                strong_Hessian_eigenvalues=np.linalg.eigvalsh(strong),
                restoring_sectors=restoring_sectors(strong, leading, G),
                physical_unit_controls=physical_hessian_controls(model, dimensionless, q, parts),
                original_local_heavy_Hessian_eigenvalues=np.linalg.eigvalsh(leading),
                whole_heavy_geometry=geometry, actual_Ward=ward, trajectories=trajectories))
        grid_rows.append(dict(grid=size, volume=model.count,
            finite_frame_energy_per_cell=model.energy, gradient=model.gradient,
            gradient_norm=float(np.linalg.norm(model.gradient)),
            stationary_at_this_actual_grid=bool(np.linalg.norm(model.gradient) < 2e-8),
            endpoint_average_controls=endpoint_average_controls(model),
            native_endpoint_control=native_control(model, angles) if size in (3, 4) else None,
            q_rows=rows))
    if source_hashes() != identities:
        raise RuntimeError('Supplier/source/proof changed during execution; receipt rejected')
    return dict(source_sha256=identities, source_bindings_unchanged=True,
        governing_plan=PLAN, assignment_plan_revision=PLAN_REVISION, template_revision=TEMPLATE_REVISION,
        inputs=dict(frame_grid=frame_grid, original_bare={**BARE, 'a': spacing}, stiffness=STIFFNESS/spacing,
            grids=grids, q_indices=q_indices, lambdas=lambdas, p=p, s=s, centre_Z4_labels=centre,
            static_reference_separation=separation, native_frame_toron=native_frame_toron),
        source_owned_original_frame=frame, selected_Gram=selected['G'],
        selected_Gram_diagnostics=selected,
        frame_scope='finite periodic original-heavy Gram minimizer; not continuum/global quantum certificate',
        law=dict(original_heavy_coefficient='Lambda', alignment='.2 Lambda^(5/4)',
            colour_plaquette='.7 Lambda^(5/4)', colour_electric='.3 Lambda^-p Casimir',
            original_field_kinetic='sqrt(Lambda)/2 times Cartesian -Delta',
            explicit_changed_field_kinetic='Lambda^-s/2 times Cartesian -Delta',
            whole_filling='NH=NL=2V vacuum; retained complete light Fock and full15V Gauss',
            extra_local_27CAR_supplier_energy=False, compact_U1='unchanged, not computed by these colour principal diagnostics'),
        symbolic_asymptotics=dict(slow_uniform_frequency=(1-s)/2,
            slow_stiff_field_frequency=(1.25-s)/2, stiff_colour_frequency=(1.25-p)/2,
            slow_uniform_field_width=-(1+s)/4, slow_stiff_field_width=-(1.25+s)/4,
            stiff_colour_width=-(1.25+p)/4,
            original_uniform_field_frequency=.75, original_stiff_field_frequency=.875,
            q0_original_charge='sqrt(Lambda) I^-1', q0_slow_charge='Lambda^-s I^-1',

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Different noncompact photon law: Coulomb source theorem and coupled diagnostic.

The CLI is intentionally run by the integration owner after all suppliers land.
No finite oscillator/Fourier result is promoted to a full microscopic theorem.
"""
from __future__ import annotations
import argparse
import hashlib
import itertools
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any
if __name__ == '__main__':
    for key in ('OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS', 'MKL_NUM_THREADS', 'OMP_NUM_THREADS'):
        os.environ[key] = '1'
import numpy as np
from scipy import sparse
from scipy.sparse.linalg import eigsh
from scipy.special import eval_genlaguerre, gammaln
from numpy.polynomial.hermite import hermgauss

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
PLAN = 'issue-222-continuing-backward-20260930'
PLAN_REVISION = 'a406dca7a4cc642318250c028a763daa96fa66a5999da5dae0c96e53910c5c91'


def accept(error, assertion, tolerance=2e-8):
    if not np.isfinite(error) or error > tolerance:
        raise AssertionError(f'{assertion}: {error} > {tolerance}')
    return float(error)


def reject(call):
    try:
        call()
    except AssertionError:
        return True
    raise AssertionError('Adverse implementation passed the physical assertion')


def basis(number):
    return [sum(1 << i for i in occupied) for occupied in itertools.combinations(range(8), number)]


def ladder(source, target, mode):
    index = {word: i for i, word in enumerate(target)}
    rows, columns, values = [], [], []
    for i, word in enumerate(source):
        if not word & (1 << mode):
            new = word | (1 << mode)
            if new in index:
                rows.append(index[new]); columns.append(i)
                values.append((-1.) ** ((word & ((1 << mode)-1)).bit_count()))
    return sparse.csr_matrix((values, (rows, columns)), shape=(len(target), len(source)))


def occupation(words):
    return np.array([(word & 15).bit_count() for word in words], dtype=float)


def unit(words, i, j):
    below = basis(words[0].bit_count()-1)
    return ladder(below, words, i) @ ladder(below, words, j).getH()


def phase_galerkin(count, coefficient, length):
    """Actual matrix elements of exp(i coefficient z), not exp(i truncated z)."""
    argument = coefficient*length/np.sqrt(2)
    rows, columns = np.indices((count, count))
    low, high = np.minimum(rows, columns), np.maximum(rows, columns)
    difference = high-low
    return (np.exp(-argument**2/2+(gammaln(low+1)-gammaln(high+1))/2)
            *(1j*argument)**difference
            *eval_genlaguerre(low, difference, argument**2))


def photon(count, radius, ue, restoring, theta, *, compact=False, erase_harmonic=False):
    labels = np.arange(-radius, radius+1)
    length = (ue/restoring)**.25
    oscillator = sparse.diags(np.sqrt(ue*restoring)*(2*np.arange(count)+1))
    ih = sparse.eye(len(labels), format='csr')
    if compact:
        # A genuinely wrong substitution, tested against the same quadratic form.
        cos = phase_galerkin(count, np.sqrt(2), length).real
        nodes, weights = hermgauss(max(80, 4*count))
        poly = np.zeros((count, len(nodes))); poly[0] = np.pi**(-.25)
        if count > 1: poly[1] = np.sqrt(2)*nodes*poly[0]
        for n in range(1, count-1):
            poly[n+1] = np.sqrt(2/(n+1))*nodes*poly[n]-np.sqrt(n/(n+1))*poly[n-1]
        q2 = (poly*(weights*(length*nodes)**2))@poly.T
        oscillator = oscillator-sparse.csr_matrix(restoring*q2)+sparse.csr_matrix(restoring*(np.eye(count)-cos))
    kinetic = ue*(labels+theta)**2/6
    if erase_harmonic: kinetic[:] = 0
    result = sparse.kron(oscillator, ih)+sparse.kron(sparse.eye(count), sparse.diags(kinetic))
    transverse = np.array([1., -1., 0.])/np.sqrt(2)
    steps = (1, 1, -2)
    phases = []
    for value, step in zip(transverse, steps):
        shift = sparse.diags(np.ones(len(labels)-abs(step)), -step, shape=(len(labels), len(labels)), format='csr')
        phases.append(sparse.kron(sparse.csr_matrix(phase_galerkin(count, value, length)), shift, format='csr'))
    return result.tocsr(), phases, labels


def coupled(number, count, radius, ue, restoring, theta, hopping=.23, *, compact=False, frozen=False, erase_harmonic=False) -> dict[str, Any]:
    words = basis(number); n = occupation(words)
    ph, phases, labels = photon(count, radius, ue, restoring, theta, compact=compact, erase_harmonic=erase_harmonic)
    ip = sparse.eye(ph.shape[0], format='csr'); im = sparse.eye(len(words), format='csr')
    # Complete canonical occupations; fixed negative reference at site1 in N=5.
    electric = sparse.kron(sparse.diags(ue*(n-2)**2/3), ip, format='csr')
    oscillator = sparse.kron(im, ph, format='csr')
    light = sparse.csr_matrix(electric.shape, dtype=complex)
    for phase in phases:
        for colour in range(4):
            term = sparse.kron(unit(words, colour, colour+4), phase, format='csr')
            light += -hopping*(term+term.conjugate().transpose())
    if frozen:
        # An actual wrong consumer, not a flag claiming an unchanged ground.
        light = sparse.csr_matrix(light.shape, dtype=complex)
    return dict(H=(electric+oscillator+light).tocsr(), electric=electric, photon=oscillator,
                light=light, words=words, n=n, ph=ph, labels=labels, phases=phases)


def ground(model, tolerance=2e-9):
    H = model['H']; rng = np.random.default_rng(2221005)
    initial = rng.normal(size=H.shape[0])
    values, vectors = eigsh(H, k=1, which='SA', v0=initial, tol=tolerance/20, maxiter=10000)
    psi = vectors[:, 0]; energy = float(values[0])
    residual = np.linalg.norm(H@psi-energy*psi)
    accept(residual, 'actual coupled canonical eigen residual', tolerance*max(1., abs(energy)))
    return energy, psi, residual

def enlarged_residual(count, radius, ue, restoring, theta, energy, psi):
    """Leakage into a strictly larger true Galerkin basis; not full-space proof."""
    larger = coupled(4, count+2, radius+2, ue, restoring, theta)
    embedded = np.zeros((70, count+2, 2*(radius+2)+1), dtype=complex)
    cell = psi.reshape(70, count, 2*radius+1)
    embedded[:, :count, 2:-2] = cell
    vector = embedded.reshape(-1)
    residual = float(np.linalg.norm(larger['H']@vector-energy*vector))
    return dict(enlarged_residual=residual, oscillator_count=count+2, harmonic_radius=radius+2,
                retained_oscillator_edge_probability=float(np.sum(abs(cell[:, -2:, :])**2)),
                retained_harmonic_edge_probability=float(np.sum(abs(cell[:, :, [0, -1]])**2)),
                full_space_residual_certified=False)


def source_maps(neutral, charged, refs=4):
    ip = sparse.eye(neutral['ph'].shape[0], format='csr')
    return [sparse.csr_matrix(sparse.kron(ladder(neutral['words'], charged['words'], a), ip, format='csr'), copy=False) for a in range(refs)]


def measure(neutral, charged, psi, energy, *, refs=4):
    maps = source_maps(neutral, charged, refs)
    images = [a@psi for a in maps]
    weight = sum(float(np.vdot(v, v).real) for v in images)
    cost = sum(np.vdot(v, charged['H']@v).real for v in images)/weight-energy
    comm = sum(np.vdot(v, charged['H']@v-a@(neutral['H']@psi)).real for a, v in zip(maps, images))/weight
    electric = sum(np.vdot(v, charged['electric']@v-a@(neutral['electric']@psi)).real for a, v in zip(maps, images))/weight
    light = sum(np.vdot(v, charged['light']@v-a@(neutral['light']@psi)).real for a, v in zip(maps, images))/weight
    mean = np.vdot(psi, sparse.kron(sparse.diags(neutral['n']), sparse.eye(neutral['ph'].shape[0]))@psi).real
    second = np.vdot(psi, sparse.kron(sparse.diags((neutral['n']-2)**2), sparse.eye(neutral['ph'].shape[0]))@psi).real
    weighted = sum(np.vdot(psi, a.getH()@a@(neutral['H']@psi)).real for a in maps)/weight
    # Photon-alone Rayleigh difference need NOT be the electric commutator.
    ph_difference = sum(np.vdot(v, (charged['electric']+charged['photon'])@v).real for v in images)/weight-np.vdot(psi, (neutral['electric']+neutral['photon'])@psi).real
    neutral_light = float(np.vdot(psi, neutral['light']@psi).real)
    return dict(weight=weight, mean=float(mean), variance_about_two=float(second), cost=float(cost),
                commutator=float(comm), electric_commutator=float(electric), light_commutator=float(light),
                weighted_neutral=float(weighted), photon_alone_difference=float(ph_difference),
                neutral_light_energy=neutral_light, independent_light_commutator=-neutral_light/4)


def physical_assertions(report, ue, *, omit_cross=False):
    covariance = report['variance_about_two']/3
    predicted = ue*(1/3-(0 if omit_cross else covariance))
    return dict(norm=accept(abs(report['weight']-2), 'complete four-reference norm is exactly2'),

                full=accept(abs(report['cost']-report['electric_commutator']-report['light_commutator']), 'full source Rayleigh transfer, not photon energy'))


def coulomb_torus(size, displacement):
    modes = np.array(list(itertools.product(range(size), repeat=3)))
    k = 2*np.pi*modes/size
    eigenvalues = np.sum(2-2*np.cos(k), axis=1)
    keep = eigenvalues > 1e-14
    r = np.sum(2*(1-np.cos(k[keep]@np.asarray(displacement)))/eigenvalues[keep])/size**3
    return float(r)


def wavepacket_error(ue, physical_momentum_variance):
    """Symmetric direct-integral packet around minimizing Bloch fibre.

    The same periodic-cell vector is used in nearby fibres. Linear current is
    retained before symmetric integration; only its integral vanishes.

    return ue*physical_momentum_variance


def packet_measurement(model, psi, ue, theta, width=.08) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Normalized uniform Bloch density: exact quadratic Gauss quadrature."""
    if abs(theta)+width >= .5:
        raise ValueError('Packet support must stay inside this chosen Bloch cell')

    weights = weights/2
    offsets = width*nodes
    labels = model['labels']
    count = model['ph'].shape[0]//len(labels)
    probabilities = np.sum(abs(psi.reshape(len(model['words']), count, len(labels)))**2, axis=(0, 1))
    differences = []
    for offset in offsets:
        # Actual fibre-H difference; every hop and restoring coordinate remains.
        delta = ue*((labels+theta+offset)**2-(labels+theta)**2)/6
        differences.append(float(probabilities@delta))
    actual = float(weights@np.asarray(differences))
    variance = float(weights@(offsets**2)/6)
    predicted = wavepacket_error(ue, variance)
    accept(abs(actual-predicted), 'same normalized Bloch-packet kinetic excess')

def supplier_upper(ue, coulomb_r, light_bound, reference_kinetic_bound, reference_current_bound,

    values = (ue, coulomb_r, light_bound, reference_kinetic_bound, reference_current_bound,

No microscopic occupation-sign operators: CAR occurs in code_isometry comparison

from __future__ import annotations

from scipy.linalg import expm

def original_endpoint(phi_x, phi_y, link, axis, band):
    """Actual h[x,y] endpoint average; link convention from BulkQuantumLaw."""
    _, paths = scalar_paths(band)
    scalar = next(s for d, s in paths if d[axis] == 1)
    fx = np.einsum('m,mij->ij', scalar, phi_x)
    fy = np.einsum('m,mij->ij', scalar, phi_y)
    return (fx @ link + link @ fy) / 2


class OriginalBosonicLaw:
    """Lazy full heavy/light original-Phi coefficient supplier.

    Each output is a local Pauli-even bilinear coefficient, not a CAR matrix.
    Site callbacks retrieve only the selected site and its three neighbours.
    Fields remain arbitrary Cartesian traceless Hermitian, links arbitrary SU4,
    and EM is a real noncompact coordinate. No selected Dirac frame is input.
    """
    def __init__(self, size, band, heavy_scale, penalty, defect_coupling):
        if size < 3 or min(heavy_scale, penalty, defect_coupling) <= 0:
            raise ValueError('Finite positive scales and periodic N>=3 required')
        self.size, self.band, self.heavy_scale = size, band, heavy_scale
        self.penalty, self.defect_coupling = penalty, defect_coupling
        self.onsite, self.paths = scalar_paths(band)

    def local_matter_coefficients(self, site, field_at, colour_link_at, em_at):
        site = tuple(site)

            onsite = scale*self.onsite*phi[0]

                yield ((species,site,i),(species,site,j),onsite[i,j],None)

                target=tuple(target)

                if species == 'L':

                for i,j in itertools.product(range(4), repeat=2):

                    yield ((species,site,i),(species,target,j),coefficient[i,j],(site,axis))
                    yield ((species,target,j),(species,site,i),np.conj(coefficient[i,j]),(site,axis))

    def field_potential_at(self, phi, outgoing):
        """Full quartic/alignment local potential; colour magnetic is per face."""
        gram=np.einsum('mij,nji->mn',phi,phi).real/4
        quartic=self.heavy_scale*(2/self.band.a)*np.sum(gram*gram)/2
        alignment=0.

class NativeOriginalModel(BosonicEdgeModel):
    """Eight modes, local bulk/ref trees, two bridges and one auxiliary loop."""
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__(8, tuple((i, i+1) for i in range(7)) + ((0, 7),))
        self.tree_edges = tuple((i, i+1) for i in range(7))
        self.bulk_modes = tuple(range(4))
        self.reference_modes = tuple(range(4, 8))
        self.defect_edge = (0, 7)
        word = ['I'] * len(self.edges)
        word[self.edge_index[self.defect_edge]] = 'Z'
        self.defect = tensor_pauli(word)

    def tree_bilinear(self, target, source):
        if target == source:
            return self.n(source)
        step = 1 if target > source else -1
        path = tuple(range(source, target+step, step))
        return self.bilinear(target, source, path=path)

    def encode_even(self, matrix, modes=None):
        modes = tuple(range(self.vertices)) if modes is None else tuple(modes)
        matrix = np.asarray(matrix, dtype=complex)
        if matrix.shape != (len(modes), len(modes)):
            raise ValueError('Coefficient matrix/mode mismatch')
        result = np.zeros_like(self.identity)
        for i, target in enumerate(modes):
            for j, source in enumerate(modes):
                if matrix[i, j] != 0:
                    result += matrix[i, j] * self.tree_bilinear(target, source)
        return result

    def code_isometry(self, number=None):
        """Comparator-only global phase alignment, valid for each even filling."""
        masks, basis = self.occupation_basis(number)
        phases = np.zeros(len(masks), dtype=complex)
        primitives = [basis.conj().T @ self.hop(i, j) @ basis
                      for i, j in self.tree_edges]
        references = [reference_hop(self.vertices, masks, i, j)
                      for i, j in self.tree_edges]
        for root in range(len(masks)):
            if abs(phases[root]) > 0:
                continue
            phases[root] = 1
            queue = deque([root])
            while queue:
                column = queue.popleft()
                for q, f in zip(primitives, references):
                    for a, b in ((q, f), (q.conj().T, f.conj().T)):
                        for row in np.flatnonzero(abs(b[:, column]) > .5):
                            if abs(phases[row]) == 0:
                                phases[row] = a[row, column]*phases[column]/b[row, column]
                                queue.append(int(row))
        return masks, basis * phases[None, :]

def reference_sector_embedding(model, modes=None, branch=1) -> ReferenceEmbedding:
    """Actual local wedge3 bar4 / wedge1 4, not an odd parity spectator.

    Plus branch neutral n_ref=4, charge q_ref=n_ref-4 on admitted 3/4.
    Minus branch neutral n_ref=0, charge q_ref=n_ref on admitted 0/1.
    Other occupations have finite gauge-invariant penalties, not hard deletion.
    """
    modes = model.reference_modes if modes is None else tuple(modes)
    if len(modes) != 4 or branch not in (-1, 1):
        raise ValueError('Four reference colours and branch +/-1 required')
    ident = model.identity
    nref = np.zeros_like(ident)
    for mode in modes:
        nref += model.n(mode)
    projectors = []
    for count in range(5):
        p = np.zeros_like(ident)
        for occupied in itertools.combinations(modes, count):
            term = ident.copy()
            for i in modes:
                term = term @ (model.n(i) if i in occupied else ident-model.n(i))
            p += term
        projectors.append(p)
    neutral = 4 if branch == 1 else 0
    charged = 3 if branch == 1 else 1
    return ReferenceEmbedding(number=nref, neutral=projectors[neutral], charged=projectors[charged],
                charge=nref-neutral*ident, unwanted=ident-projectors[neutral]-projectors[charged],
                projectors=projectors, representation='bar4' if branch == 1 else '4')


def reference_source(model, coefficients, branch=1) -> tuple[np.ndarray,list[np.ndarray]]:
    """Four internal reference components retained with actual source norm."""
    embedding = reference_sector_embedding(model, branch=branch)
    coefficients = np.asarray(coefficients, dtype=complex)
    if coefficients.shape != (4,):
        raise ValueError('Actual source needs all four colour coefficients')
    pieces = []
    for bulk, ref in zip(model.bulk_modes, model.reference_modes):
        operator = model.tree_bilinear(bulk, ref) if branch == 1 else model.tree_bilinear(ref, bulk)
        pieces.append(embedding['charged'] @ operator @ embedding['neutral'])
    result = np.zeros_like(model.identity)
    for coefficient,piece in zip(coefficients,pieces):
        result += coefficient*piece
    return result,pieces

def topology_probe(size=3):
    """GF2 local-cycle rank, no Hilbert matrix; bounded native positive control."""
    if not 3<=size<=5:
        raise ValueError('Native cycle proof uses only N=3..5, never Nstar')
    sites=tuple(itertools.product(range(size),repeat=3))
    def neighbour(site,axis):
        result=list(site);result[axis]=(result[axis]+1)%size
        return tuple(result)
    edges=[]
    for species in range(2):
        for site in sites:
            for axis in range(3):
                edges.append(tuple(sorted(((species,site),(species,neighbour(site,axis))))))
    edges.extend(((0,site),(1,site)) for site in sites)
    lookup={edge:j for j,edge in enumerate(edges)}
    def edge_bit(left,right):
        return 1<<lookup[tuple(sorted((left,right)))]
    faces=[]
    for species in range(2):
        for site in sites:
            for a,b in itertools.combinations(range(3),2):
                sa,sb=neighbour(site,a),neighbour(site,b)
                sab=neighbour(sa,b)
                cycle=((species,site),(species,sa),(species,sab),(species,sb))
                mask=0
                for left,right in zip(cycle,(*cycle[1:],cycle[0])):
                    mask ^= edge_bit(left,right)
                faces.append(mask)
    rectangles=[]
    for site in sites:
        for axis in range(3):
            target=neighbour(site,axis)
            rectangles.append(edge_bit((0,site),(0,target))^edge_bit((1,site),(1,target))
                              ^edge_bit((0,site),(1,site))^edge_bit((0,target),(1,target)))
    def rank(rows):
        pivots={}
        for value in rows:
            while value:
                pivot=value.bit_length()-1
                if pivot not in pivots:
                    pivots[pivot]=value;break
                value ^= pivots[pivot]
        return len(pivots)
    cycles=len(edges)-2*len(sites)+1
    local_rank=rank((*faces,*rectangles))
    wrong_debt=cycles-rank(faces)
    if cycles-local_rank!=3 or wrong_debt<=3:
        raise AssertionError('Local rectangle/torus topology contract failed')
    return dict(size=size,anchor_vertices=2*len(sites),anchor_edges=len(edges),
                cycle_rank=cycles,local_constraint_rank=local_rank,
                retained_holonomies=cycles-local_rank,
                omitted_bridge_rectangles_holonomies=wrong_debt)

def source_frame(spacing: float, reference_grid: int) -> tuple[np.ndarray, dict[str, Any]]:

    return np.array([-2 * np.vdot(difference,

    residual = max(float(np.linalg.norm(a @ b + b @ a -
                   (2 * scales[i] * np.eye(4) if i == j else 0)))
                   for i, a in enumerate(frame) for j, b in enumerate(frame))
    check(residual, 'actual source weighted Clifford frame')
    units = np.eye(16, dtype=complex).reshape(16, 4, 4)
    images = np.array([sum(a @ (a @ e - e @ a) - (a @ e - e @ a) @ a
                           for a in frame) for e in units])
    superoperator = images.reshape(16, 16).T
    values = np.linalg.eigvalsh(superoperator)
    check(float(np.linalg.norm(superoperator - superoperator.conj().T)), 'commutator Hermiticity')
    predicted = []
    for mask in range(16):
        grade = mask.bit_count()
        predicted.append(4 * sum(scales[j] for j in range(4)
                         if bool(mask & (1 << j)) == (grade % 2 == 0)))
    check(float(np.linalg.norm(values - np.sort(predicted))), 'full native Clifford commutator spectrum')
    tangents = np.array([1j * (t @ frame - frame @ t) for t in generators])
    quadratic = np.einsum('amij,bmij->ab', tangents.conj(), tangents).real
    local_values = np.linalg.eigvalsh(quadratic)
    check(float(np.linalg.norm(local_values - values[1:] / 2)), '15 Casimir local normal curvatures')
    if values[1] <= 0:
        raise AssertionError('Actual Clifford frame must have scalar-only commutant')
    check(float(np.linalg.norm(2 * np.einsum('aij,bji->ab', generators, generators) - np.eye(15))),
          'canonical SU4 generator metric')
    check(float(np.linalg.norm(sum(t @ t for t in generators) - C_F * np.eye(4))),
          'native fundamental SU4 Casimir')
    return dict(Gram_diagonal=scales.tolist(), Clifford_residual=residual,
                commutator_eigenvalues=values.tolist(), scalar_commutant_dimension=1,
                ell_min=float(values[1]), ell_max=float(values[-1]),
                local_W_quadratic_eigenvalues=local_values.tolist(),
                W_zero_set=['I', 'iI', '-I', '-iI'], centre_minima_not_deleted=True)


def packet(u: np.ndarray, eta: float, charge: int) -> complex:
    seeds = np.exp(eta * ((CENTRES.conj() * np.trace(u)).real - 4))
    return complex(np.dot(CENTRES ** charge, seeds))


def packet_derivatives(u: np.ndarray, eta: float, charge: int,
                       generators: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    seeds = np.exp(eta * ((CENTRES.conj() * np.trace(u)).real - 4))
    traces = np.einsum('aij,ji->a', generators, u)
    seed_derivatives = eta * (1j * CENTRES.conj()[:, None] * traces[None, :]).real * seeds[:, None]
    return np.einsum('k,ka->a', CENTRES ** charge, seed_derivatives)


def native_controls(frame: np.ndarray, generators: np.ndarray,
                    eta: float, seed: int = 222970) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Exercise actual noncentral matrices, all 15 derivatives and full Gauss action."""
    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
    raw = rng.normal(size=(4, 4)) + 1j * rng.normal(size=(4, 4))
    u, triangular = np.linalg.qr(raw)
    phases = np.diag(triangular) / abs(np.diag(triangular))
    u = u * phases[None, :]
    u[:, 0] /= np.linalg.det(u)
    direction = np.einsum('a,aij->ij', rng.normal(size=15), generators)
    near = expm(.25j * direction)
    controls = [u, near, np.diag(np.exp(1j * np.array([.6, -.2, .1, -.5])))]
    centre_w = [potential(frame, frame, z * np.eye(4)) for z in CENTRES]
    check(max(centre_w), 'all four actual centre minima')
    derivative_errors, kinetic_errors, characters, w_values = [], [], [], []
    w_derivative_errors = []
    all_derivatives = []
    epsilon = 1e-6
    ell = frame_control(frame, generators)
    for matrix in controls:
        w = potential(frame, frame, matrix)
        if w <= 1e-6:
            raise AssertionError('Noncentral control failed to reach positive W')
        w_values.append(w)
        scalar_distance = 4 - abs(np.trace(matrix)) ** 2 / 4
        check(max(0., ell['ell_min'] * scalar_distance - w), 'global noncentral W lower')
        check(max(0., w - ell['ell_max'] * scalar_distance), 'global noncentral W upper')
        w_gradient = potential_derivatives(frame, matrix, generators)
        w_fd = np.array([(potential(frame, frame, expm(1j * epsilon * t) @ matrix) -
                          potential(frame, frame, expm(-1j * epsilon * t) @ matrix)) /
                         (2 * epsilon) for t in generators])
        w_derivative_errors.append(float(np.linalg.norm(w_gradient - w_fd)))
        for q in range(4):
            value = packet(matrix, eta, q)
            analytic = packet_derivatives(matrix, eta, q, generators)
            numerical = np.array([(packet(expm(1j * epsilon * t) @ matrix, eta, q) -
                                   packet(expm(-1j * epsilon * t) @ matrix, eta, q)) /
                                  (2 * epsilon) for t in generators])
            scale = max(1e-12, abs(value), float(np.linalg.norm(analytic)))
            derivative_errors.append(float(np.linalg.norm(analytic - numerical)) / scale)
            characters.append(max(abs(packet(z * matrix, eta, q) - z ** q * value)
                                  for z in CENTRES) / max(1e-12, abs(value)))
            traces = np.trace(matrix)
            trace2 = np.trace(matrix @ matrix)
            a = packet(matrix, eta, (q - 1) % 4)
            b = packet(matrix, eta, (q + 1) % 4)
            c = 2 - abs(traces) ** 2 / 8
            d = (trace2 - traces ** 2 / 4) / 2
            fierz = eta ** 2 / 4 * ((abs(a) ** 2 + abs(b) ** 2) * c -
                                   2 * (a * b.conjugate() * d).real)
            kinetic_errors.append(abs(float(np.vdot(analytic, analytic).real) - fierz) /
                                  max(1e-18, float(np.vdot(analytic, analytic).real)))
            if matrix is near:
                all_derivatives.append(dict(charge=q, real=np.real(analytic).tolist(),
                                            imaginary=np.imag(analytic).tolist()))
    check(max(derivative_errors), 'all15 actual packet left-Casimir derivatives', 2e-7)
    check(max(w_derivative_errors), 'all15 actual native potential derivatives', 2e-8)
    check(max(kinetic_errors), 'all15 derivative sum versus exact Fierz formula', 2e-8)
    check(max(characters), 'actual fundamental and antifundamental centre characters', 2e-8)
    # An external fund at L and anti-fund at R are spectator sources, not CAR particles.
    # Their coefficient matrix M=U/2 has unit norm, and transforms hL M hR^dagger.
    h_left = expm(.31j * np.einsum('a,aij->ij', rng.normal(size=15), generators))
    h_right = expm(.27j * np.einsum('a,aij->ij', rng.normal(size=15), generators))
    moved = h_left @ near @ h_right.conj().T
    left_fields = h_left @ frame @ h_left.conj().T
    right_fields = h_right @ frame @ h_right.conj().T
    covariance = abs(potential(left_fields, right_fields, moved) - potential(frame, frame, near))
    check(covariance, 'actual independent endpoint SU4 potential invariance')
    m = near / 2
    derivatives = np.array([1j * t @ m for t in generators])
    cross = np.einsum('ij,aij->a', m.conj(), derivatives)
    extra = float(np.linalg.norm(derivatives) ** 2)
    check(float(np.linalg.norm(cross)), 'all15 transporter kinetic cross cancellation')
    check(abs(extra - C_F), 'normalized reference transporter native Casimir cost')
    # Test the product identity with arbitrary vector-valued neutral derivatives.
    neutral = rng.normal(size=7) + 1j * rng.normal(size=7)
    neutral /= np.linalg.norm(neutral)
    d_neutral = rng.normal(size=(15, 7)) + 1j * rng.normal(size=(15, 7))
    product_derivatives = (derivatives[:, :, :, None] * neutral[None, None, None, :] +
                           m[None, :, :, None] * d_neutral[:, None, None, :])
    difference = float(np.linalg.norm(product_derivatives) ** 2 - np.linalg.norm(d_neutral) ** 2)
    check(abs(difference - C_F), 'matrix-valued neutral section exact kinetic product identity', 2e-8)
    gauss_left, gauss_right = [], []
    for t in generators:
        left_fd = (expm(1j * epsilon * t) @ near - expm(-1j * epsilon * t) @ near) / (4 * epsilon)
        right_fd = (near @ expm(-1j * epsilon * t) - near @ expm(1j * epsilon * t)) / (4 * epsilon)
        gauss_left.append(float(np.linalg.norm(left_fd - 1j * t @ m)))
        gauss_right.append(float(np.linalg.norm(right_fd + 1j * m @ t)))
    check(max(gauss_left + gauss_right), 'all15 actual SU4 Gauss reference pair', 2e-8)
    wrong_reference_residual = float(np.linalg.norm(1j * generators[0] @ m + 1j * m @ generators[0]))
    if wrong_reference_residual <= 1e-3:
        raise AssertionError('Wrong fundamental/fundamental pairing control failed')
    # Full SU4 packet section on the actual two-frame orbit, not just its Z4 label.
    vector_left = np.eye(4, dtype=complex)[:, 0]
    vector_right = np.eye(4, dtype=complex)[:, 1]
    def charged_section(gl: np.ndarray, gr: np.ndarray, link: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
        body = gl.conj().T @ link @ gr
        return packet(body, eta, 1) * np.outer(gl @ vector_left, (gr @ vector_right).conj())
    section = charged_section(h_left, h_right, moved)
    section_scale = max(1e-12, float(np.linalg.norm(section)))
    section_isotropy = max(
        float(np.linalg.norm(charged_section(z * h_left, h_right, moved) - section)) / section_scale
        for z in CENTRES)
    section_isotropy = max(section_isotropy, max(
        float(np.linalg.norm(charged_section(h_left, z * h_right, moved) - section)) / section_scale
        for z in CENTRES))
    section_gauss = []
    for t in generators:
        plus, minus = expm(1j * epsilon * t), expm(-1j * epsilon * t)
        dl = (charged_section(plus @ h_left, h_right, plus @ moved) -
              charged_section(minus @ h_left, h_right, minus @ moved)) / (2 * epsilon)
        dr = (charged_section(h_left, plus @ h_right, moved @ plus.conj().T) -
              charged_section(h_left, minus @ h_right, moved @ minus.conj().T)) / (2 * epsilon)
        section_gauss.extend((float(np.linalg.norm(dl - 1j * t @ section)) / section_scale,
                              float(np.linalg.norm(dr + 1j * section @ t)) / section_scale))
    check(section_isotropy, 'packet/reference descent under both independent frame centres', 2e-8)
    check(max(section_gauss), 'packet/reference complete field-link SU4 Gauss action', 2e-7)
    # Two-edge noncentral path: interior Gauss cancels; both edge Casimirs remain.
    path_links = (near, u)
    path = path_links[0] @ path_links[1] / 2
    path_derivatives = np.concatenate((
        np.array([1j * t @ path for t in generators]),
        np.array([path_links[0] @ (1j * t) @ path_links[1] / 2 for t in generators])))
    path_cross = np.einsum('ij,aij->a', path.conj(), path_derivatives)
    path_casimir = float(np.linalg.norm(path_derivatives) ** 2)
    check(float(np.linalg.norm(path_cross)), '30 distinct-edge path derivative cross cancellations')
    check(abs(path_casimir - 2 * C_F), 'two-edge fullSU4 path Casimir cost')
    interior = expm(.17j * direction)
    check(float(np.linalg.norm((path_links[0] @ interior.conj().T) @
          (interior @ path_links[1]) / 2 - path)), 'noncentral interior Gauss path cancellation')
    return dict(seed=seed, all15_derivatives_at_noncentral_controls=True,
                noncentral_W=w_values, centre_W=centre_w,
                packet_derivative_relative_error=max(derivative_errors),
                potential_derivative_error=max(w_derivative_errors),
                kinetic_Fierz_relative_error=max(kinetic_errors),
                centre_character_relative_error=max(characters),
                native_near_point_derivatives=all_derivatives,
                endpoint_SU4_covariance_error=float(covariance),
                reference_pair_norm=float(np.linalg.norm(m) ** 2),
                reference_pair_Casimir_extra=extra,
                all15_cross_inner_products_real=cross.real.tolist(),
                all15_cross_inner_products_imaginary=cross.imag.tolist(),
                arbitrary_neutral_section_kinetic_extra=difference,
                full_left_right_Gauss_derivative_error=max(gauss_left + gauss_right),
                packet_reference_frame_isotropy_error=section_isotropy,
                packet_reference_all15_Gauss_error=max(section_gauss),
                two_distinct_edge_path_Casimir_extra=path_casimir,
                path_all30_cross_inner_product_error=float(np.linalg.norm(path_cross)),
                wrong_reference_representation_residual=wrong_reference_residual)


def haar_packet_integrals(eta: float, grid: int, scales_sum: float) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Entire SU4 Weyl torus; no omitted group angles or finite irrep cutoff.

    Class packet permits exact conjugation averaging of W. This quadrature
    estimates exact infinite-Haar formulas; its grid difference is not a
    rigorous interval error or a solved rotor ground.
    """
    angles = 2 * np.pi * np.arange(grid) / grid - np.pi
    theta2, theta3 = np.meshgrid(angles, angles, indexing='ij')
    norms = np.zeros(4)
    gradients = np.zeros(4)
    w_numerators = np.zeros(4)
    seed_norm = seed_gradient = seed_w = haar_mass = 0.
    inverse_centres = CENTRES.conj()
    for theta1 in angles:
        eigenvalues = np.stack((np.full_like(theta2, np.exp(1j * theta1), dtype=complex),
                               np.exp(1j * theta2), np.exp(1j * theta3),
                               np.exp(-1j * (theta1 + theta2 + theta3))), axis=-1)
        trace = eigenvalues.sum(axis=-1)
        trace2 = (eigenvalues ** 2).sum(axis=-1)
        vandermonde2 = np.ones_like(theta2)
        for i in range(4):
            for j in range(i + 1, 4):
                vandermonde2 *= abs(eigenvalues[..., i] - eigenvalues[..., j]) ** 2
        weight = vandermonde2 / (24 * grid ** 3)
        haar_mass += float(weight.sum())
        seeds = np.exp(eta * ((inverse_centres[:, None, None] * trace[None, :, :]).real - 4))
        packets = 4 * np.fft.ifft(seeds, axis=0)
        c = np.maximum(0., 2 - abs(trace) ** 2 / 8)
        d = (trace2 - trace ** 2 / 4) / 2
        averaged_w = 8 / 15 * scales_sum * np.maximum(0., 16 - abs(trace) ** 2)
        density = abs(packets) ** 2
        for q in range(4):
            a, b = packets[(q - 1) % 4], packets[(q + 1) % 4]
            kinetic_density = eta ** 2 / 4 * ((abs(a) ** 2 + abs(b) ** 2) * c -
                                             2 * (a * b.conj() * d).real)
            if float(kinetic_density.min()) < -1e-12:
                raise AssertionError('Exact Casimir kinetic density became negative')
            norms[q] += float(np.sum(weight * density[q]))
            gradients[q] += float(np.sum(weight * np.maximum(0., kinetic_density)))
            w_numerators[q] += float(np.sum(weight * density[q] * averaged_w))
        f2 = seeds[0] ** 2
        # |grad ReTr U|^2=(C-Re D)/2 with the same canonical all15 generators.
        seed_norm += float(np.sum(weight * f2))
        seed_gradient += float(np.sum(weight * f2 * eta ** 2 * (c - d.real) / 2))
        seed_w += float(np.sum(weight * f2 * averaged_w))
    check(abs(haar_mass - 1), 'complete SU4 Weyl Haar normalization', 2e-10)
    if min(norms) <= 0 or seed_norm <= 0:
        raise AssertionError('Whole-Haar sector packet has zero sampled norm')
    return dict(grid=grid, eta=eta, Haar_mass=haar_mass,
                sector_norms=norms.tolist(), sector_Casimir= (gradients / norms).tolist(),
                sector_W=(w_numerators / norms).tolist(),
                one_well_norm=seed_norm, one_well_Casimir=seed_gradient / seed_norm,
                one_well_W=seed_w / seed_norm,
                status='full-torus deterministic quadrature estimate, not rigorous interval')


def rigorous_packet_bound(eta: float, u4: float, v_alignment: float,
                          ell_max: float) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Explicit analytic bound for global analytic exp-seed packets, no support cut."""
    if eta < 1:
        raise ValueError('Analytic packet bound uses eta>=1')
    # Canonical metric 2Tr(dX^2), Haar normalized to one; proof derives this volume.
    group_volume = 2 ** 7.5 * (2 * math.pi) ** 9 / 6
    ball_volume = math.pi ** 7.5 / math.gamma(8.5)
    jacobian_lower = float(np.sinc(1 / (2 * np.pi)) ** 12)
    seed_norm_lower = ball_volume / group_volume * math.exp(-.5) * jacobian_lower * eta ** -7.5
    overlap = math.exp(-OVERLAP_EXPONENT * eta)
    overlap_ratio = overlap / seed_norm_lower
    log_tail = math.log(8 * eta) - math.log(seed_norm_lower)
    deficit_upper = min(8., (log_tail / 2 + 1) / eta)
    seed_kinetic_upper = 15 / 4 * u4 * eta
    seed_potential_upper = 2 * v_alignment * ell_max * deficit_upper
    seed_energy_upper = seed_kinetic_upper + seed_potential_upper
    cross_form_ratio = (2 * u4 * eta ** 2 + 4 * v_alignment * ell_max) * overlap_ratio
    certificate = 3 * overlap_ratio < 1
    common_upper = ((seed_energy_upper + 3 * cross_form_ratio) / (1 - 3 * overlap_ratio)
                    if certificate else None)
    deviation = ((3 * cross_form_ratio + 3 * overlap_ratio * seed_energy_upper) /
                 (1 - 3 * overlap_ratio) if certificate else None)
    return dict(eta=eta, normalized_Haar_volume=group_volume,
                seed_norm_rigorous_lower=seed_norm_lower,
                Haar_Jacobian_lower_in_unit_ball=jacobian_lower,
                offdiagonal_seed_overlap_rigorous_upper=overlap,
                overlap_to_norm_rigorous_upper=overlap_ratio,
                trace_deficit_expectation_upper=deficit_upper,
                one_well_kinetic_upper=seed_kinetic_upper,
                one_well_potential_upper=seed_potential_upper,
                one_well_trial_energy_upper=seed_energy_upper,
                four_sector_common_trial_upper=common_upper,
                each_sector_trial_deviation_from_one_well_upper=deviation,
                four_sector_trial_spread_upper=2 * deviation if deviation is not None else None,
                positive_norm_certificate=certificate,
                status='analytic inequalities; floating coefficients are not outward-rounded intervals',
                actual_ground_energy_computed=False)


def rotation_control(frame: np.ndarray) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Derive compensator from the actual Clifford frame; distinguish gauge restoration."""
    scales = np.einsum('mij,mji->m', frame, frame).real / 4
    gamma1 = frame[1] / math.sqrt(float(scales[1]))
    gamma2 = frame[2] / math.sqrt(float(scales[2]))
    generator = gamma1 @ gamma2 / 2
    endpoint = expm(2 * math.pi * generator)
    check(float(np.linalg.norm(endpoint + np.eye(4))), 'Clifford compensator endpoint minusI')
    # A moving normalized fundamental basis has A=S^dagger dS=generator.
    # Parallel transporter cancels the endpoint overlap, giving the restored loop +I.
    connection_transport = expm(-2 * math.pi * generator)
    restored = endpoint @ connection_transport
    check(float(np.linalg.norm(restored - np.eye(4))), 'compact pure gauge/Berry restored loop plusI')
    return dict(compensator_endpoint_real=np.real(endpoint).tolist(),
                compensator_endpoint_imaginary=np.imag(endpoint).tolist(),
                localized_fundamental_centre_character_at_minusI=-1,
                antifundamental_reference_centre_character_at_minusI=-1,
                co_rotated_pair_centre_character=1,
                restored_compact_gauge_Berry_loop_error=float(np.linalg.norm(restored - np.eye(4))),
                full_physical_restored_rotation=1,
                fixed_reference_operation_not_equal_to_co_rotation=True,
                mechanical_half_spin_derived=False,
                limitation='A localized projective factor needs mobile charge and symmetry factorization; not supplied by this matrix lift.')


def run(*, spacing: float = 1., reference_grid: int = 32,
        lambdas: tuple[float, ...] = (1., 16., 256.),
        haar_grids: tuple[int, ...] = (96, 128, 160)) -> dict[str, Any]:
    if not np.isfinite(spacing) or not 0 < spacing <= 1 or reference_grid < 3:
        raise ValueError('Require 0<a<=1 and source grid>=3')
    if not lambdas or any(not np.isfinite(x) or x < 1 for x in lambdas):
        raise ValueError('Require finite Lambda>=1')
    if not haar_grids or min(haar_grids) < 8:
        raise ValueError('Require Haar grids>=8')
    identities = source_hashes()
    frame, selected = source_frame(spacing, reference_grid)
    generators = matrix_unit_basis() / math.sqrt(8)
    geometric = frame_control(frame, generators)
    native = native_controls(frame, generators, eta=4.)
    scales_sum = float(sum(geometric['Gram_diagonal']))
    rows = []
    for stiffness in lambdas:
        u4 = .3 * stiffness ** -.5
        v_alignment = ALIGNMENT / 8 * stiffness ** 1.25
        eta = max(4., math.sqrt(64 * v_alignment * scales_sum / (15 * u4)))
        estimates = []
        for grid in haar_grids:
            data = haar_packet_integrals(eta, grid, scales_sum)
            energies = u4 * np.asarray(data['sector_Casimir']) + v_alignment * np.asarray(data['sector_W'])
            data['sector_trial_energies'] = energies.tolist()
            data['one_well_trial_energy'] = u4 * data['one_well_Casimir'] + v_alignment * data['one_well_W']
            data['fund_antifund_trial_energy_difference'] = float(energies[1] - energies[3])
            check(abs(float(energies[1] - energies[3])), 'inversion fundamental/antifund packet symmetry', 2e-8)
            estimates.append(data)
        refinement = None
        if len(estimates) > 1:
            previous, final = estimates[-2:]
            e_prev = np.asarray(previous['sector_trial_energies'])
            e_final = np.asarray(final['sector_trial_energies'])
            refinement = dict(norm_max_relative_difference=float(np.max(abs(
                np.asarray(previous['sector_norms']) / np.asarray(final['sector_norms']) - 1))),
                energy_max_relative_difference=float(np.max(abs(e_prev - e_final) / np.maximum(1., abs(e_final)))),
                interval_error_certificate=False)
        normal = np.asarray(geometric['local_W_quadratic_eigenvalues'])
        rows.append(dict(Lambda=stiffness, u4=u4, alignment_multiplier=v_alignment, eta=eta,
                         colour_plaquette_multiplier=COLOUR_PLAQUETTE * stiffness ** 1.25,
                         Haar_packet_estimates=estimates, refinement_diagnostic=refinement,
                         rigorous_smooth_packet_bound=rigorous_packet_bound(eta, u4, v_alignment, geometric['ell_max']),
                         frozen_single_link_harmonic_ground=float(np.sqrt(u4 * v_alignment * normal).sum()),
                         frozen_single_link_harmonic_first_gap=float(2 * math.sqrt(u4 * v_alignment * normal[0])),
                         harmonic_scope='frozen-field single-link quadratic form only, not full Gauss/BH spectrum',
                         exact_scalar_fundamental_ground_splitting_interval=[0., u4 * C_F],
                         exact_scalar_antifundamental_ground_splitting_interval=[0., u4 * C_F],
                         full_original_external_pair_energy_difference_upper_per_distinct_edge=u4 * C_F,
                         full_original_pair_difference_lower_bound_proved=False))
    rotations = rotation_control(frame)
    if source_hashes() != identities:
        raise RuntimeError('Source/proof changed during original centre-charge execution')
    return dict(source_sha256=identities, source_bindings_unchanged=True,
                governing_plan=PLAN, assignment_plan_revision=PLAN_REVISION,
                native_law='u4*(-Delta_SU4)+(J/8)*Lambda^(5/4)*W; Tr(TaTb)=delta_ab/2; all SU4 points retained',
                candidate_trajectory=dict(u4_prefactor=.3, u4_power=-.5,
                    original_heavy_coefficient='Lambda', field_kinetic_original='sqrtLambda/2',
                    compatible_alternative_field_kinetic='Lambda^(-1/2)/2; separately changed law, no phase assumption'),
                source_selection=selected, geometric_controls=geometric,
                native_SU4_controls=native, rows=rows, rotation_boundary=rotations,
                full_Gauss_pair_theorem=dict(
                    references='spectator fundamental at L and antifundamental at R, not original light-CAR insertion',
                    section='M_gamma(U)=ordered_product_gamma(U)/2 tensor arbitrary exact neutral physical state',

def metric_constants(band: RotationBand, gram: RealArray, volume: int) -> dict[str, float]:
    """Exact formulas evaluated numerically; no outward interval certificate."""
    if band.m <= 0 or band.r < 0 or band.improved or volume <= 0:
        raise ValueError('Need m>0, r>=0, original nearest-axis law and finite V>0')
    if gram.shape != (4, 4) or not np.all(np.isfinite(gram)):
        raise ValueError('Need a finite full4x4 Gram matrix')
    check(float(np.linalg.norm(gram-gram.T)), 'symmetric native Gram')
    if np.linalg.eigvalsh(gram)[0] <= 0:
        raise ValueError('The exact effective theorem requires positive definite Gram')
    b = np.linalg.solve(gram[1:, 1:], gram[1:, 0])
    schur = float(gram[0, 0]-gram[0, 1:]@b)
    if schur <= 0:
        raise ValueError('Spatial Gram Schur complement must be strictly positive')
    mu = band.m*math.sqrt(schur)
    sf = float((3*band.r**2*gram[0, 0]+band.v**2*np.trace(gram[1:, 1:]))/band.a**2)
    return dict(spatial_Schur=schur, mu=mu, SF=sf,
        neutral_metric_upper=volume*sf/(4*mu**2),
        discarded_Wilson_aligned_mu=band.m*math.sqrt(float(gram[0, 0]))

def chiral_basis(frame: Matrix, gram: RealArray, volume: int) -> tuple[Matrix, Matrix, Matrix]:
    """Spatial-orthogonal beta, not an isotropic replacement of the native frame."""
    b = np.linalg.solve(gram[1:, 1:], gram[1:, 0])
    residual = frame[0]-np.einsum('i,ijk->jk', b, frame[1:])
    schur = float(gram[0, 0]-gram[0, 1:]@b)
    beta = residual/math.sqrt(schur)
    chirality = SELECTED[0]@SELECTED[1]@SELECTED[2]@SELECTED[3]
    check(float(np.linalg.norm(beta@beta-np.eye(4))), 'Schur beta square')
    check(float(np.linalg.norm(beta@frame[1:]+frame[1:]@beta)), 'beta orthogonal to all spatial fields')
    check(float(np.linalg.norm(chirality@frame+frame@chirality)), 'fixed Gamma5 fullmetric anticommutation')
    values, vectors = np.linalg.eigh(chirality)

    check(float(np.linalg.norm(plus.conj().T@minus)), 'chiral basis orthogonality')

def wilson_matrix(law: BulkQuantumLaw, links: Matrix, phases: RealArray) -> Matrix:
    """W=sum(I-Re T_i), using actual centre links and compact U1 phases."""
    result = 3*np.eye(law.volume, dtype=complex)
    for x in range(law.volume):
        for axis in range(3):
